messages:
cheng: Quick heads up — seeing a micro-regression on causal paths when head_dim % 16 != 0. Repro on sm90 with the v3 selector.
anya: ugh, repro steps? small or big impact on p50/p99?
cheng: small but consistent. p50 regressed ~1.6x for token step on seqlen 512, head_dim 30. p99 noisier. Repro:
```
python -m bench.run --model redwood/ft-small --seqlen 512 --head_dim 30 --kernel auto --causal true --runs 50
```
sam: saw that too locally. Quick numbers from my run (avg token latency ms):
- v2 selector forced: 8.1
- v3 selector (auto): 13.5
- fallback (cpu): 40+
Logs show kernel switch at step 3 after kv warmup.
perf-bot: Profiling summary (3412345600): hot funcs: sdpa_v3_kernel_dispatch, causal_prefetch_path, kv_cache_fetch. CPU/GPU overlap low during first 8 tokens.
raj: hypothesis: v3's head-slice tiling assumes head_dim aligned to 8 or 16; for 30 it picks a slow fallback kernel. Also sequence-length gating may pick different tiling at seqlen 512 vs 256.
anya: does kv cache warmup make it worse? i.e., first tokens hit different path and then you get mismatch?
cheng: yes — observed that cold requests take v3 path which has larger setup cost; after KV warms up selector switches but the transition causes micro-thrashing in the scheduler and degrades p50. Also prefetch/pipeline not overlapping due to tiny microbatches.
sam: quick patch I tried: force v2 for causal when head_dim % 16 != 0 and seqlen >= 384. p50 back to 8.3ms. Not ideal but low-risk.
raj: alternative: update autotuner to include head_dim mod buckets (<=8, 9-15, 16-31, 32+) and record cold vs steady-state latencies in the probe. Then add hysteresis so selector doesn't flip in-flight.
anya: can we add a short-term canary that forces selector hysteresis on a subset? e.g., require 8 consecutive samples before switching.
perf-bot: Canary proposal created: CANARY-1723 (force hysteresis=8). Baseline/variant runs enqueued.
cheng: also attach a short trace snippet showing the flip:
```
[0.001s] enqueue request id=345
[0.003s] selector: choose sdpa_v3 (cold)
[0.010s] kernel launch sdpa_v3 (setup heavy)
[0.020s] kv cache warm; selector recompute -> sdpa_v2
[0.021s] schedule sdpa_v2 concurrently -> scheduler contended -> latency bump
```
sam: filed perf ticket PLT-4321 with benchmark + artifact. tagging @runtime on the ticket.
raj: long-term: update kernel cost model to include head_dim misalignment penalty and kv-warmup stage. Also add a lightweight microprobe at request start to decide stable path before heavy setup.
anya: sounds good. For immediate mitigation: deploy-bot, can we canary force v2 on 10% of runtime-1 hosts?
deploy-bot: canary config applied: runtime-1 cluster, 10% hosts -> selector.override=force_v2_causal_headmod_non16, expires in 24h. :white_check_mark:
cheng: thanks — will monitor p50/p99 and KV hit ratios. If we see improvement we can roll to 50% and then switch to autotuner patch.
anya: cool. I'll pair with sam to draft the autotune change and add unit tests for headmod buckets.
sam: +1 — will run extended load tonight and post updated numbers. :coffee:
